Kanal has cookies (and also bread in the bakery).

Kanal wants to offer an experience that engages and inspires, both in the museum and online. That's why this website uses cookies: to analyse visitor data, improve the site and show content that is tailored to your personal tastes. Some cookies are necessary for the proper functioning of the website and cannot be refused. Want to know more? Click on settings. The cookie policy and your consent apply to the following domains: kanal.brussels and tickets.kanal.brussels.
